subject: [PATCH 2/5] fuse: convert ext_map iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations in the ext_map code for FUSE to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. This callback is generated using a macro that wraps the existing iomap_iter_next() helper, allowing it to finish any previous mapping and produce the next one if necessary. The conversion does not introduce any functional changes.

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Approved the conversion to ->iomap_next(), but suggested CC'ing relevant lists for new iomap uses.
reviews.raw_body:
Hmm, it would have been nice to CC adding a new creative iomap use
to the relevants lists..

Anyway, the conversion looks good:
